text: Keeps business code calling enqueue_notification inside its own transaction, with the monolith notifications table as the first durable record and no caller changes.

Moves notifications from the monolith to the service only through the at-least-once message broker, with no database access across the boundary in either direction, and handles redelivered or republished messages without duplicate sends.
Uses the notification id as MailRelay's idempotency_key on every send, including on the old worker, starting before any type is cut over.
Applies the existing retry policy on the service side: 5 attempts, backoff of 1/2/4/8 minutes, then mark failed and page on-call.

Cuts over one type at a time in the order shipping_update, order_confirmed, password_reset, with at least 3 days between moves, and moves password_reset only after p99 latency under 60 s is shown on order_confirmed.
Provides a per-type rollback by flag flip that neither loses nor re-sends notifications already in flight.
Removes the old worker only after password_reset has run on the service for 7 days.
Is a numbered, step-by-step Markdown plan that states, for each step, what starts it, what data moves, where state lives and what happens on failure.
